messages.author: 43350febf2ab32d8
messages.subject: Problems running advanced.procD.lm function
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm trying to obtain the matrix of Procrusted Distances among a set of 18 populations. Untill this week everything works fine, but yesterday, running the same script, with the same dataset as before I got an error when running advanced.procD.lm:

fit.pop <- advanced.procD.lm(shape ~ 1,
                         shape ~ pop,
                         groups = ~ pop,
                         iter = 999, data=saldf)

Error: It was not possible to find model terms in the global environment or the data frame used.


However, this model works fine:

fit.pop <- advanced.procD.lm(shape ~ sex,
                         shape ~ sex*pop,
                         groups = ~ pop,
                         iter = 999, data=saldf)


I also performed individual Procrustes ANOVAS por shape, pop, and checked the dataframe. In addition, as I was working with the GitHub Stable version of geomorph, I tried with both, the Develop version and the CRAN one.

Could anyone help me with this problem please?

Thanks in advance,

Lucía

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Problems running advanced.procD.lm function
parts:
Dear Lucia,

I apologize for the inconvenience. I am in the process of making some updates to RRPP and have made some changes on Github. Because advanced.procD.lm depends on RRPP, there are some cascading effects that I am currently sorting out. 

In the interim, you might try installing both geomorph and RRPP from CRAN. Also, be aware that advanced.procD.lm and some other functions will be deprecated in preference to better alternatives. These updates should occur within the next couple of weeks. I only mention this because advanced.procD.lm has proven inflexible to updates of other functions and needs to be retired. Thus, we will not seek to fix emergent issues, as you are now experiencing. 

Finally, before trying anything you might try reinstalling RRPP from GitHub first, later today, as I will push some new updates there in the next hour, as we prepare that package for a CRAN submission. 

Again, sorry for this inconvenience. You just caught use in a remodeling phase. 

Best,
Mike 

Sent from my iPhone
